messages:
elaine: quick q — our console shows an estimated token/byte cost for embeddings. how should we surface cost when a single request contains mixed dims (e.g. [384, 512, 768])?
jorge: my gut is: show per-item estimate + aggregated cost and highlight the 'highest-cost dimension' so users know why it's larger.
sam: agreed on per-item estimates, but we need clear UX for routing: do we auto-split client arrays into homogenous batches or route mixed-dim batches to the splitter service?
elaine: current runtime accepts mixed dims and invokes splitter which can cause extra latency. product asked for a clear console signal so users can opt into "auto-split" vs "fail-fast".
priya: +1 for an explicit toggle in the console and API header. suggested header: `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true|false` and a console checkbox with documentation bubble.
nikhil: telemetry note: emit `embed.request.shape_hint` with fields: dims_list, client_sent_hint (bool), split_count, routed_to_splitter (bool). need to ensure sensitive data stripped.
sam: also we should surface a small warning in the request preview: "Mixed dims detected — routing to splitter may add ~50-200ms". keep the message compact.
elaine: implementation question: if auto-split is off and we get mixed dims, do we 400 or accept and route to splitter silently? ops prefers fail-fast for predictable SLOs.
jorge: ops argument makes sense. Can we do a soft-fail first: return 202 with an `x-embed-action` header that says `split-scheduled` + a console toast explaining the delay? less annoying than outright 400.
priya: product: users expect determinism. I'd rather default to 400 for mixed dims on v1 of the change, with an "allow-mixed-dims" per-key feature flag for power users. then in a later release flip default to soft-split with an opt-out.
nikhil: rollout plan: canary the console toggle to 5% of orgs, record metrics `embed.split.latency_p50/p95`, `embed.request.failures.shape_mismatch`, and `console.toggle.enable_autosplit_count`.
elaine: what about billing/quotas? should quota units be per-embedding (count) or per-byte/dim (cost-weighted)? currently quota is per-embedding unit, which penalizes larger dims equally to small dims.
sam: propose hybrid: quota is count-based for rate limiting but billing/console-estimates use a cost-weighted unit (e.g., embed_unit_cost = dims * base_rate). console should display both: "Quota usage: 12/1000 embeddings" and "Estimated bill: $0.45".
jorge: also add a backend-only metric `embed.effective_unit` so we can query historical cost mismatch between quota and billing. useful for migration.
nikhil: note for telemetry schema: keep signal names short, standardize tags. example event: `embed.request` { outcome: passed|split|rejected, dims_max: 768, batch_size: 24, cost_estimate_usd: 0.012 } — but we only record cost_estimate_usd as a numeric tag.
elaine: UX ask: console's sample payload generator should let users toggle "Homogenize dims" which will show them the split plan and estimated latency. can we add a small preview panel?
priya: yep — mock already in Figma. I'll share link in #design after standup.
sam: infra: need a quick API contract for the header and response codes. suggestion: 400 + body {"error":"mixed_dims","hint":"set X-Embed-AutoSplit or homogenize input"} or 202 + header if soft route. which one are we standardizing on?
elaine: product decision: default to 400. expose feature-flag `allow_mixed_dims` for beta. console will default to showing the homogenize toggle and a link to doc.
jorge: tech follow-ups: 1) add `shape_hint` in request logs 2) route planner should expose `split_plan_id` in traces 3) add sampling for payloads to S3 (scrubbed) for debugging.
nikhil: i'll add the telemetry events + dashboards: a) timeseries: split_rate / total_requests b) p95 latency by split vs no-split c) billing delta chart. will add them to dev dashboard and make a console-facing summary card.
elaine: cool. action items: @priya prepare the console mock + copy, @jorge open runtime PR to add `X-Embed-AutoSplit` and `mixed_dims` error, @nikhil add telemetry schema and dashboard panels, @sam update API docs. I'll open the ticket and tag folks.
embed-bot: ticket created: EI-1429 "Embedding mixed-dim UX + autosplit feature-flag" — PT assigned to elaine.
priya: thanks — will post Figma link in 30m.
sam: noted, I'll draft the API contract after lunch.
jorge: i'll prototype split_plan_id in tracer today.
nikhil: starting dashboard widgets by EOD.
elaine: thanks everyone :raised_hands: we'll reconvene after the PRs land to decide default flip timing.
